title: No finite rectangular charge--spatial hierarchy closes the bare finite-p Holder induction

finite_rectangle.assumed_hierarchy: H^s_x D(Q^m) controlled only for 0<=s<=S and 0<=m<=N with finite S,N
finite_rectangle.top_corner: the finite-p electric estimate at the top charge/spatial corner requires H^(S+3/p)_x D(Q^(N+1))
finite_rectangle.outside: for every finite p, both the charge index and spatial exponent lie beyond the controlled rectangle
finite_rectangle.iteration: raising either finite ceiling only moves the exposed corner and does not close the same bare Holder induction
finite_rectangle.witness: the K1382 diagonal q_N=|k_N| modes make the missing top-corner control quantitative
finite_rectangle.method_boundary: this excludes finite rectangular closure by bare Holder/Sobolev only
finite_rectangle.surviving_routes: null-form cancellation, covariant spacetime estimates, a proved diagonal anisotropic energy, or a summable infinite analytic/Gevrey hierarchy remain open
